senses.gloss:
गि(गे)ष्णुः [गै इष्णुच् आद्गुणः]
—1 A singer.
—2 Especially, a Brāhmaṇa versed in the hymns of the Sāmaveda and who chants them.
गेष्णुः [गै इष्णुच्] A singer, an actor.
गेष् €1 Ā. (गेषते, गेष्ण) To seek, search, investigate; cf. गवेष्.

—1 A singer, a professional singer; Ch. Up. 1. 6.
—2 An actor.
